entries.description: Streamable-http MCP door over the Family Office Knowledge Graph: holds the index, forwards to the node that serves the record. Five tools: resolve_family_office, get_record, list_events_since, list_aliases, list_nodes. No authentication for reads.

entries.description: A2A Agent Card: the five tools as skills; supported interfaces the apex door, the node doors and HTTP+JSON; security schemes none, office OAuth and x402.

entries.description: GET /api answers 402 (x402 v2, $0.01 USDC on Base mainnet, scheme exact); with payment it returns { receipt, statement, data } — the graph index of record signed, with a receipt that resolves forever at /x402/receipt/{nonce}.

Where do receipts resolve and which key signs them?
